theorem bbolt.node.write.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] : bbolt.node.write.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.node.write.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (n : Loc) (nv : go_etcd_io.bbolt.node) (ins : List go_etcd_io.bbolt.internal.common.Inode) (ms : List bbolt.InodeM)
    (dq dqi dqb : DFrac) (p : Loc) (hdr : go_etcd_io.bbolt.internal.common.Page) (R : Nat),
    hdr.count' = W16 0 →
      hdr.flags' = W16 0 →
        ms.length < 65535 →
          bbolt.pageFits ms →
            (bbolt.pageBody true ms).length ≤ R →
              (nv.isLeaf' = false → ∀ (m : bbolt.InodeM), m ∈ ms → m.pgid ≠ hdr.id') →
                0 < p.addr →
                  p.addr + 16 + ↑R ≤ maxAddr →
                    ⊢
                      ∀ Φ,
                        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗
                            typedPointsto n nv dq ∗
                              ownSlice nv.inodes' ins dqi ∗

                                    iprop(⌜it.flags' = m.flags ∧ it.pgid' = m.pgid⌝ ∗
                                        ownSlice it.key' m.key dqb ∗ ownSlice it.value' m.value dqb)) ∗
                                  typedPointsto p hdr (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                    bytesPointsto (p.add 16) (DFrac.own 1) (List.replicate R (W8 0)) -∗
                          ▷
                              (typedPointsto n nv dq ∗
                                  ownSlice nv.inodes' ins dqi ∗
                                    ([∗list] it;m ∈ ins;ms,
                                        iprop(⌜it.flags' = m.flags ∧ it.pgid' = m.pgid⌝ ∗
                                            ownSlice it.key' m.key dqb ∗ ownSlice it.value' m.value dqb)) ∗
                                      typedPointsto p (bbolt.hdrWritten hdr nv.isLeaf' ms.length) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                        bytesPointsto (p.add 16) (DFrac.own 1)
                                          (bbolt.pageBody nv.isLeaf' ms ++
                                            List.replicate (R - (bbolt.pageBody nv.isLeaf' ms).length) (W8 0)) -∗
                                Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
